research_question: Holding the exact per-target E054 union18 candidate set fixed, does one deterministic numeric-order snake partition change line-level hit concentration metrics relative to the original E054 line assignment?
novelty_vs_completed_work: E054 tested the frozen rolling-concentration candidate union and its original allocator; E059 decomposed candidate recall before allocation.
E060 changes no candidate number and evaluates exactly one fixed alternative partition of the same frozen union18, isolating line assignment from candidate selection.
This is a historical allocator sensitivity diagnostic only; it is not an independent signal family, model-selection sweep, prospective confirmation, or purchase candidate.

runner.runtime: Node.js-compatible deterministic JavaScript; same algorithm executed in Code Mode V8

fixed_comparison.reference_allocator: Original E054 three-line partition from the frozen PREDICTIONS.csv.
fixed_comparison.alternative_allocator: For each target, take the exact union18 from the E054 three lines, sort ascending, then assign indices [0,5,6,11,12,17] to line 1, [1,4,7,10,13,16] to line 2, and [2,3,8,9,14,15] to line 3.
fixed_comparison.candidate_union: Exactly the same frozen 18 numbers per target for both allocators; no candidate addition, removal, re-ranking, or score calculation.
fixed_comparison.target_outcomes: Read only after both portfolios are constructed, solely to score them.

geometry.invariant: The alternative partition must preserve the exact E054 union18 for every target.

random_baseline.method: Uniformly shuffle labels 1..45 with xorshift32 and partial Fisher-Yates, then partition the first 18 shuffled labels into three ordered groups of six. This is an exact-geometry disjoint-union18 null.

inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the frozen exact null; for each replicate sample 17 contiguous 50-target blocks with replacement, each valid block start equally likely.
inference.strict_gate_diagnostic: All four adjusted CI lower bounds must be strictly >0 and at least 65% of the 17 non-overlapping 50-target any2-delta blocks must be positive.

contamination.rounds_1244_1249: Previously inspected/live-history material; not a clean holdout.
contamination.evaluation_class: Historical sensitivity diagnostic only; no prospective confirmation.

reporting.primary_endpoint: Paired difference in line-level max_hits, any2, and any3 between the original E054 partition and the fixed numeric-order snake partition.
reporting.secondary_endpoint: Strict-gate diagnostic for each partition against the unchanged exact union18 null.
reporting.union_coverage: Must be identical by construction; any mismatch is a verification failure.
reporting.promotion_effect: None. No model promotion, no STRICT_PASS_READY, no candidate ranking, no purchase lines, no freeze or seal.
